thag4.1:1.1: Tikanipāto niṭṭhito. {CATUKKANIPĀTO.} Alaṃkatā suvasanā mālinī candanussadā majjhe mahāpathe nārī turiye naccati naṭṭakī. || ||
thag4.1:2.1: piṇḍikāya paviṭṭho 'haṃ gacchanto naṃ udikkhisaṃ alaṃkataṃ suvasanaṃ maccupāsaṃ va oḍḍitaṃ. || ||
thag4.1:3.1: tato me manasīkāro yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahū, nibbidā samatiṭṭhata, || ||
thag4.1:4.1: tato cittaṃ vimucci me, passa dhammasudhammataṃ: tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti. || || Nāgasamālathero.
